headline: Umqerra records a status change in its fibre-line refit log
summary: Umqerra Fibres moved the fibre-line refit to status R7 in its internal project log. The log identifies the refit but lists no production volumes. The accompanying glossary defines R7 as physical commissioning accepted by the plant engineer, with the refitted line released for operation.
